title: List pull requests with CI status
description: Open pull requests plus any merged or closed within the window, newest first, each with its head-SHA CI rollup (runs / passing / failing / pending). Use this for "which PRs are stuck", "which open PRs have failing or pending CI", and per-author or per-repo PR triage. open_to_merge_seconds is coarse: it is merged_at minus created_at and fuses draft and ready-for-review time, so report it as "open to merge", never "cycle time". ready_to_merge_seconds is the true cycle time: merged_at minus the last observed ready-for-review transition (only the last draft/ready switch counts), or minus created_at for a merged PR verifiably never drafted. Null means "not observed" (the issue-events window is bounded), never zero. CI counts come from the latest run per workflow on the head SHA and can lag until the workflow_run webhook settles a late completion. Cost and billable minutes can lag new CI by up to 5 minutes. Bots and drafts are present; exclude them (author.is_bot, is_draft) for throughput questions. To list every PR merged in a window, pass state=merged: open PRs then do not count against the page, and rows come newest merged_at first with number as the tie-breaker. Pages hold up to 1000 rows; while truncated is true, call again with offset increased by limit, and keep date_to fixed across pages so new merges do not move rows between pages.

methodDocumentation.text: Open pull requests plus any merged or closed since date_from (default -30d), newest first, each with its head-SHA CI rollup. Pass state to list one state only. The list is paged by limit and offset; when more match, `truncated` is true and the ci_cards counts can exceed it. open_to_merge_seconds is coarse: it fuses draft and ready-for-review time; CI counts can lag until late completions settle. Cost and billable minutes can lag new CI by up to 5 minutes.
